newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DHL opens two new facilities in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: DHL opens two new facilities in Belgium.

text.p: DHL Belgium has officially opened two new facilities in Diegem, near Brussels. The express company has invested 500 million Belgium francs in its new Belgium headquarters and in a sorting centre, a DHL spokesman said in a statement here.
The 4,400 sq m sorting centre, which is primarly for the Belgium market, lies on the Woluwelaan in Diegem. Sorting was previously carried out in Zaventum Airport where DHL's European hub is based.
This latest move brings DHL Belgium's operational, administrative and commercial activity under one roof, he added.
The courier company now has 683 staff in Belgium, the majority of these will be employed in the new facilities. This compare with just three people when it opened in Belgium in 1978.
Diegem was chosen because of its central position, less than five minutes from the Brussels Ringroad and also close to DHL's European sorting centre at the airport.
US integrator, UPS, is also building a facility in the area. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
